description: Get one full listing including contact details. PAID via x402 ($0.01 USDC): the call returns a payment-required error until an x402 payment is attached to the request _meta. Clients without x402 support can use the same price over plain HTTP: GET https://api.easyrider.one/listings/{listing_id} with an x402 HTTP client. Payment is only settled on success.
name: get_listing
